d:
The Suns defeated the Kings, 128-107 tonight in Sacramento. Devin Booker contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 6 assists 2 rebounds and 2 three pointers, with Dillon Brooks of the Suns adding an additional 29 points (12-18 FG, 5-9 3P) in the game. Darius Acuff Jr. finished with a team-high 36 points along with 6 assists for the Kings in the losing effort. The Suns improve their record to 7-7 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-13 for the season.
